sources.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
sources.snippet: Believable proxies of human behavior can empower interactive applications ranging from immersive environments to rehearsal spaces for interpersonal communication to prototyping tools. In this paper, we introduce generative agents--computational software agents that simulate believable human behavior.
